2. The petitioner has filed this petition under Section-482 Cr.P.C. seeking quashing of the F.I.R. in Kalahandi Kegaon P.S. Case No.10 of 2022 corresponding to C.T. Case No.72/112 of 2022 pending in the Court of the learned Additional District Judge-cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act,

entities.text: Kalahandi Kegaon P.S. Case No.10 of 2022
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner hands up the statement of the victim namely Baibi Sahu under Section-161 Cr.P.C.
She has stated that she was not kidnapped by anyone.
It was rather her family tried to get her married forcefully with someone.
She has also stated that she is in relationship with the petitioner.
4. It appears during the investigation that the Investigating Officer has found that the date of birth of the victim girl is 30.04.2005.
Therefore, she has invoked Section-6 of the POCSO Act and also Sections-363, 366, 376(2)(n) and Section-376 IPC.

The charge sheet has not yet been filed.
5.

Taking into consideration the aforementioned facts and submissions, it would be appropriate that the Investigating Officer should verify the fact and place on record regarding the fact as to whether they are living together or not.

The Investigating Officer should place on record the present status of the case, taking into account the statement of the victim recorded under Section-164 Cr.P.C.
6.

List this matter on 08.02.2024.
7.
A free copy of this order be supplied to Mr. Maharaj, learned Additional Standing Counsel.
